detail.longDescription: I am combining some git repositories. The first step in the process is to clone each original repository and usie git filter-repo to prepend a tag to each commit message. The purpose of the tag is to tell which repository each commit is from. The command that I use is git filter-repo --message-callback 'return b"repo: " + message' . It works otherwise as expected, but it causes all hidden files (files with leading dot in their names) to disappear. What am I doing wrong? Edit: I am doing this in Linux so the missing files are "natively" hidden files. The missing files exist in a fresh clone of the original repository, but not after running git filter-repo. When I run git show for a commit that touches one of those files in the filtered repository, there is no sign of that file. The files are project configuration files of a tool I am using i.e. not some local configurations.
